roadbuild.step.transitions: the road with {two, select, yes {two transitions} other {a transition}}
roadbuild.status.transitions: Built the road with {two, select, yes {transitions} other {a transition}} to the road of another width. Ctrl+Z takes it all back.
roadbuild.status.go_on: Click to go on, Esc ends the road.
roadbuild.status.across: Built the road across {splines} with new crossroads (#{junctions}){note}. Ctrl+Z takes it all back.
@roadbuild.status.across: {splines} names the splines (roadbuild.splines); {note} is an optional addition about parallel roads
roadbuild.status.tee: Built the road{hasCrossed, select, yes { across {splines} with new crossroads,} other {}} joined to spline #{spline} with a new T junction (#{junction}){note}. Ctrl+Z takes it all back.
roadbuild.fail.changed: a spline the road joins changed on the way.
roadbuild.fail.too_many: it crosses more than {max} roads; build it in shorter parts.
roadbuild.fail.shallow: it crosses spline #{id} at {angle, number, 0}°, too shallow for crossroads; switch off Make junctions to build it without one.
roadbuild.note.parallel_built: , and {count, plural, one {# parallel road} other {# parallel roads}} {distance, number, 0.#} m beside it with crossroads of their own
roadbuild.note.parallel_beside: , and {count, plural, one {# parallel road} other {# parallel roads}} {distance, number, 0.#} m beside it
roadbuild.junction.whole: {what} and the road {tail, select, to {to it} other {through them}}
@roadbuild.splines: {ids} is a list of numbers separated by ", #"
roadbuild.plan.continue: Click to continue spline #{id} from its {end, select, end {end} other {start}}.
roadbuild.plan.start_port: Click to start a road at {port}; it suggests the profile {profile}.
roadbuild.plan.start: Click to start a road. Free spline ends show as circles and free connection points of junctions as diamonds; starting on one continues it.
roadbuild.plan.next: Click where the road should go next; Esc ends it.
roadbuild.plan.control: Click the control point: the road leaves towards it{along, select, yes {, along the road it continues} other {}}. Then click where it ends; Esc ends the road.
roadbuild.meets.one: Crosses spline #{id} after {along, number, 0} m: a click makes crossroads there.
roadbuild.meets.many: Crosses {count} roads, after {list} m: a click makes crossroads at each.
roadbuild.meets.shallow: Spline #{id} is crossed too shallowly for crossroads, so the road cannot be built with junctions.
roadbuild.meets.tee: Ends on spline #{id}: a click joins it with a new T junction.
roadbuild.meets.transition: Joins a road of another width: a click puts a transition between them.
@roadbuild.besides: {message} is a message of MapWorks in English
roadbuild.describe.main: {length, number, 0.0} m in {pieces, plural, one {# spline} other {# splines}}, {straight, select, yes {straight} other {radius {radius, number, 0} m}}{corner, select, yes {, corner rounded with a radius of {cornerRadius, number, 0.0} m (the road before is cut back {trim, number, 0.0} m)} other {}}, gradient up to {gradient, number, 0.0} %, end height {height, number, 0.00} m{join, select, spline {; joins spline #{id}} port {; joins {port}} other {}}.
@roadbuild.issue: {severity} is the word Error or Warning or Note in English; {message} a message of MapWorks in English
roadbuild.next.curved: Click the control point the road leaves towards, then where it ends
roadbuild.started.port: Road started at {port}, leaving it the way the point faces. {next}; Esc ends it.
roadbuild.no_parallel: No parallel road was built here, as the road {reason, select, corner {rounds a corner or ends on a road, junction or connection point.} other {meets a junction or a road of another width.}}
roadbuild.step.parallel: the road with its parallel roads
roadbuild.built: Built {meters, number, 0.0} m of road in {count, plural, one {# spline} other {# splines}}{rounding, select, yes {, rounding the corner with a radius of {radius, number, 0.0} m} other {}}{warnings, plural, =0 {} one { with # warning} other { with # warnings}}{note}
roadbuild.status.joined: {built}, joined to {target}. Click to start the next road.
@roadbuild.cannot: {reason} is a message from the system, in English
roadbuild.status.nothing_built: Nothing was built{before, plural, =0 {} one {, also not the # crossroads before it} other {, also not the # crossroads before it}}. At spline #{id}: {reason}
roadbuild.status.start_variant: Road in {title}: click to start a road, on a free spline end to meet it; click again for each bend, Esc ends the road. It stands alone: no junction, parallel road or terrain fitting.
roadbuild.status.start: Road: click to start a road, on a free spline end to continue it or on a free connection point of a junction; click again for each bend, Esc ends the road.
roadbuild.status.junction_failed: The junction could not be made: {reason}
@roadbuild.status.junction_failed: {reason} is a message from the system, in English
@roadbuild.status.no_junction: {reason} is a message from the system, in English
roadbuild.status.no_points: the made junction has no connection points.
roadbuild.status.insert_failed: The junction could not be inserted: {reason}
@roadbuild.status.insert_failed: {reason} is a message from the system, in English
roadbuild.status.cut_blocked: The road cannot be cut for a junction here: {references}.
roadbuild.status.to_junction: The road cannot be built to the junction: {reason}
@roadbuild.status.to_junction: {reason} is a message from the system, in English
roadbuild.status.build_failed: The road could not be built: {reason}
@roadbuild.status.build_failed: {reason} is a message from the system, in English
roadbuild.status.transition_failed: The transition could not be made: {reason}
@roadbuild.status.transition_failed: {reason} is a message from the system, in English
roadbuild.status.transition_place_failed: The transition could not be placed: {reason}
@roadbuild.status.transition_place_faile: {reason} is a message from the system, in English
roadbuild.status.choose_profile: Choose a spline profile in the road panel first.
roadbuild.status.control_far: Click the control point a little away from the start.
roadbuild.status.control_set: Control point set. Click where the curve ends; Esc takes the control point back.
roadbuild.status.corner_failed: The corner could not be rounded: {reason}
@roadbuild.status.corner_failed: {reason} is a message from the system, in English
roadbuild.path_mode.foot: Path mode: draw a footpath over the road and its ends snap to the pavement paths and other paths of people. The paths view is on.
roadbuild.path_mode.road: Path mode: draw a path for vehicles and its ends snap to the road paths already there, so draw it the way the traffic goes. The paths view is on.
roadbuild.crossing.plan: Click a road to put a pedestrian crossing into it; switch "Insert crossing" off to build roads again.
roadbuild.crossing.no_road: No road with a carriageway here: click on the carriageway of a road.
roadbuild.crossing.variant: A chrono variant cannot have a crossing piece cut into its roads.
roadbuild.crossing.done: Put a pedestrian crossing into the road (junction #{id}). Ctrl+Z takes it back.
